description_en: Retrieves the sampling logs for a JMeter sampler based on specified conditions
description_zh: 根据条件获得JMeter采样器的采样日志
kebab_example: aliyun pts get-jmeter-sampling-logs --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --begin-time 1637157073000 --end-time 1637157076000 --report-id 7R4RE352 --agent-id 14238000 --sampler-id 0 --success true --thread main --keyword test --min-rt 0 --max-rt 1000 --response-code 200 --api-version 2020-10-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetJMeterSamplingLogs

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 请求第N页采样日志信息
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of sampling log entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: begin_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. This is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the stress testing engine. This parameter is not yet available
parameters.help_zh: 压测引擎编号，该字段暂未启用
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The serial number of the sampler. The value starts from 0
parameters.name: sampler_id

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the sampling is successful
parameters.name: success

parameters.help_en: The thread name. Fuzzy search is supported. The value is tokenized by spaces
parameters.help_zh: 线程名。支持模糊搜索，按空格分词
parameters.name: thread

parameters.help_en: The keyword. Use this parameter to perform a fuzzy search by SceneName or an exact search by SceneId
parameters.help_zh: 关键字，可以通过对场景名（SceneName）进行模糊搜索或者对场景ID（SceneId）进行精确搜索
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The minimum response time (RT). Unit: ms
parameters.name: min_rt

parameters.help_en: The maximum response time (RT). Unit: ms
parameters.name: max_rt
